product.title: Barcelona: Montserrat Hot Air Balloon Ride with Champagne Toast

description.text: See Barcelona province landscapes from the sky on this incredible hot air balloon ride. It’ll give you access to views of the province that you wouldn’t see otherwise. Stops include Montserrat. You won’t have to worry about getting hungry, as you’ll be given a welcome backpack with cookies, fruit juice, and bottled water. Ideal for visitors basing in Barcelona who want a guided city experience without coordinating metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Montserrat, a defining stop on this Barcelona sightseeing experience.
